every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 clears the text card during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D anchor rack in frame 4 is not covered by the UI panel like it is in Site 1 frame 4.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor—showing token slabs entering a digest press, anchor rack, and 7-lane gate across frames 1 to 9—to explain how Straitjacket works.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature the identical well-crafted, grounded 3D machinery, grid floor, materials, and lighting across all frames 1 through 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While typography and card styling are identical, Site 2 paces its text cards so they fade out during camera moves in frames 4 and 7, leaving the 3D scene unobstructed.

overall.reason: Site 2 improves upon the shared design by hiding the left-hand text card during intermediate scroll transitions so it never collides with the 3D machinery.
